entities.definition: Saved minimum house-battery SoC for additional afternoon direct-EVSE solar buffering while qualified solar and protected Sellable remain. A higher outside-window reserve still wins; 100% disables this extra buffer, not a separately configured keepalive.
entities.producer: EvSolarSoakNumber.native_value projects RuntimeConfiguration.ev_numbers; its setter and EV Charging policies persist the same ev_solar_soak_battery_soc_percent configuration-entry value. ActiveEvController remains the sole EV device writer.
entities.unit_and_sign: Whole percent, 0 through 100 inclusive; default 90%. This is the house battery, not the vehicle target.
entities.time_basis: Current persisted operator setting; survives reload and restart. Edits immediately reconcile existing policy and invalidate old bound mean/cadence evidence.
entities.availability: Editable while HEO is loaded even if telemetry is unavailable; missing telemetry cannot grant a positive EV command.
entities.state_vocabulary: Finite whole-number percentage; invalid dashboard edits are rejected, and a corrupt saved floor yields 100% conservatively.
consumers: Existing ActiveEvController buffered solar-spill planner and per-command authority checks

entities.definition: Saved time-weighted averaging window for reconstructed afternoon solar opportunity before upward supported-amp rounding and existing limits. Not a second measurement source, poller or EV writer.
entities.producer: EvSolarSoakNumber.native_value projects RuntimeConfiguration.ev_numbers; its setter and EV Charging policies persist the same ev_solar_soak_average_minutes configuration-entry value. ActiveEvController owns SolarSoakAverage.
entities.unit_and_sign: Whole positive minutes, 1 through 30 inclusive; default 5 minutes.
entities.time_basis: Current persisted operator setting; survives reload and restart. A changed period starts fresh qualified evidence rather than stretching old history.
entities.availability: Editable while HEO is loaded even if telemetry is unavailable; unavailable evidence still blocks new positive charging commands.
entities.state_vocabulary: Finite whole-number minutes. Invalid dashboard edits are rejected; corrupt saved periods fall back to the reviewed bounded default.
consumers: Existing ActiveEvController SolarSoakAverage and source/policy-bound history

entities.definition: Saved cadence for ordinary afternoon solar-soak current changes using the latest qualified mean. Safety cuts, verified import, lower safe ceilings and permission loss do not wait for this interval.
entities.producer: EvSolarSoakNumber.native_value projects RuntimeConfiguration.ev_numbers; its setter and EV Charging policies persist the same ev_solar_soak_adjustment_minutes configuration-entry value. Existing measured-solar reconciliation and ActiveEvController remain authoritative.
entities.unit_and_sign: Whole positive minutes, 1 through 30 inclusive; default 5 minutes.
entities.time_basis: Current persisted operator setting; survives reload and restart. Editing it immediately re-evaluates and invalidates the old bound normal-adjustment cadence.
entities.availability: Editable while HEO is loaded even if telemetry is unavailable; editing a setting never substitutes for control eligibility.
entities.state_vocabulary: Finite whole-number minutes. Invalid dashboard edits are rejected; corrupt saved periods fall back to the reviewed bounded default.
consumers: Existing measured-solar adjustment planner through ActiveEvController
